name: Staff of Striking

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Striking
powers.text: Arm it: your next hit with the staff spends up to 3 charges, an extra 1d6 Force each.

summary: +3 quarterstaff; on a hit, spend up to 3 charges for an extra 1d6 Force each.
text: This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. The staff has 10 charges. When you hit with a melee attack using it, you can expend up to 3 of its charges. For each charge you expend, the target takes an extra 1d6 Force damage. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.
